{{recipesummary|category=Sausage recipes|servings=4–6 persons|time=45 minutes|difficulty=2}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Italy|Cuisine of Italy]] | [[Cookbook:Meat|Sausage]]

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (480 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) rotini or other spiral [[Cookbook:Pasta|pasta]]
* 12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (330 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) sweet Italian [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausage]] links
* 14.5 oz (410 g) Italian-style stewed [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
* 14.5 oz (410 g) cut green Italian beans, drained
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|cooking oil]]
* 6 oz (170 g) [[Cookbook:Tomato Paste|tomato paste]]
* 1 cup (240 ml) [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]
* 2 oz (55 g) shredded [[Cookbook:Provolone Cheese|provolone]] or [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella]]

== Procedure ==
# Cook pasta and drain.
# Meanwhile, brown sliced sausage in hot oil in large [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] for 5 minutes, then drain away the fat.
# Stir in undrained tomatoes, tomato paste, broth, and drained beans. Bring to [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], then reduce heat. [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]], covered, 10 minutes.
# Stir in cooked pasta.
# Sprinkle with cheese.
